title: Smart Data Models - Brand
description: A brand operated by a legal organization. It represents a commercial identity (name, sector) decoupled from the legal entity (Organization) so that a single Organization can operate several Brands and one Brand can group several DigitalAssets (web, app, social profiles).

id.description: Unique identifier of the entity. Recommended pattern: urn:ngsi-ld:Brand:<short-name> or urn:ngsi-ld:Brand:<vatID>:<short-name> when a brand name is not globally unique.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be Brand.

name.description: Property. Commercial name of the brand.

alternateName.description: Property. Alternative or short name of the brand.

description.description: Property. Description of the brand and its activity.

items.description: NACE Rev. 2.1 code in canonical form: section letter (A-U), division (XX), group (XX.Y) or class (XX.YY). Letter and digits are NEVER concatenated.

businessSection.description: Property. List of NACE Rev. 2.1 codes that classify the economic sector(s) of the brand. Example: ['62.01', '73.11'] for IT consulting + advertising agencies. Levels can be mixed in the same list when precision varies per sector.

url.description: Property. Canonical URL of the brand (corporate site, landing, etc.).

refOrganization.description: Relationship. URN of the Organization that legally owns and operates this brand.
